notes.title: Open Beta 51 Patch Notes | To War!
notes.notes:
[img]https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/05/OB51-Launcher-Large-PatchNotes.jpg[/img]
[u][u][b]To War![/b][/u][/u][u][b]
[u]Open Beta 51 Patch Notes | June 1st[/u][/b][/u]
[url=http://forums.paladins.com/showthread.php?46-How-Hi-Rez-Makes-Games-and-Expectations-for-Beta][u]Beta Expectations[/u][/url]

[u][u][b]NEW CHAMPION: Ash, The War Machine[/b][/u][/u]

[img]https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/05/50x50Ash.png[/img]
[list]
 	[*]Abilities[/*]
[/list]
[url=https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/05/Ash_BurstCannon_256x256.png][img]https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/05/Ash_BurstCannon_256x256.png[/img][/url]

[LMB] Burst Cannon

Fire a shrapnel round every 0.9s that explodes in an AOE dealing 400 damage.

[url=https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/05/Ash_KineticBurst_256x256.png][img]https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/05/Ash_KineticBurst_256x256.png[/img][/url][RMB] Kinetic Burst

Superheat your next shrapnel round. When you next fire, the round will instantly explode in a frontal cone, dealing 300 damage and applying a knockback.

[url=https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/05/Ash_SiegeUnit_256x256.png][img]https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/05/Ash_SiegeUnit_256x256.png[/img][/url][Q] Siege Shield

Deploy a 5000 health siege shield that advances forward. Lasts 6 seconds.

[url=https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/05/Ash_ShoulderBash_256x256.png][img]https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/05/Ash_ShoulderBash_256x256.png[/img][/url][F] Shoulder Bash

Lower your shoulder and hurtle forward. Hitting an enemy will deal 800 damage and apply a strong knockback.

[url=https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/05/Ash_Dominance_256x256.png][img]https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/05/Ash_Dominance_256x256.png[/img][/url][E] Assert Dominance

Leap forward and Plant your Banner in the ground dealing 350 damage on impact and creating a Damage Immune zone for yourself that lasts 8s. You must remain in the zone to receive the Immunity.

[list]
 	[*] Legendaries
[list]
 	[*]Battering Ram
[list]
 	[*][Shoulder Bash] Gain CC Immunity and 90% Damage Reduction While Channeling Shoulder Bash.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Fortress Breaker
[list]
 	[*][Siege Shield] Siege Shield Moves 80% Slower and has 3000 More Health[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Rally Here
[list]
 	[*][Dominance] Assert Dominance now Stuns affected enemies for 2 seconds on impact and grants Allies within 100ft 20% increased Damage for 3 seconds.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Cards
[list]
 	[*]Heavy Metal
[list]
 	[*][Armor] Increase your base maximum Health by 150/300/450/600.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Indomitable
[list]
 	[*][Armor] Gain 8/16/24/32% crowd control reduction.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Fervor
[list]
 	[*][Armor] You cannot be slowed below 50/60/70/80% of your base movement speed.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]War Machine
[list]
 	[*][Armor] Eliminations reduce all cooldowns by 10/20/30/40%.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Percussion
[list]
 	[*][Kinetic Burst] Increase the knockback distance of Kinetic Burst by 8/16/24/32%.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Castle Forged
[list]
 	[*][Kinetic Burst] Reduce Cooldown of Kinetic Burst by 0.5/1/1.5/2s.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Brawl
[list]
 	[*][Kinetic Burst] Heal for 80/160/240/320 Health over 2s for each enemy hit by Kinetic burst[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Siege Engine
[list]
 	[*][Kinetic Burst] Reduce the cooldown of Siege Shield by 0.5/1/1.5/2s for each enemy hit with Kinetic Burst.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Ramparts
[list]
 	[*][Siege Shield] Reduce the Cooldown of Siege Unit by 0.5/1/1.5/2s.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Trebuchet
[list]
 	[*][Siege Shield] Generate 1/2/3/4 ammo when activating Siege Shield.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Battlement
[list]
 	[*][Siege Shield] Increase the duration of Siege Unit by .5/1/1.5/2s.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Watchtower
[list]
 	[*][Siege Shield] Siege Shield reveals nearby enemies for 1/2/3/4s.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Gate Crasher
[list]
 	[*][Shoulder Bash] Reduce the Cooldown of Shoulder Bash by 1/2/3/4s.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Furious Charge
[list]
 	[*][Shoulder Bash] Increase the knockback distance of Shoulder Bash by 8/16/24/32%.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Thrive
[list]
 	[*][Shoulder Bash] Heal for 150/300/450/600 Health when hitting with Shoulder Bash.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Vanguard
[list]
 	[*][Shoulder Bash] Gain 8/16/24/32% Damage Reduction for 2s after using Shoulder Bash.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]

[u][u][b]GENERAL[/b][/u][/u]
[list]
 	[*]Introducing “Champion Skins”
[list]
 	[*][i]“We are reorganizing how we package our Skin cosmetics in order to accommodate players seeking full outfits. Players will still be able to equip parts individually and mix & match as they like. But Accessory and Body Pieces (along with Voice Packs when available) can now be acquired together as a unit referred to as a “Champion Skin”[/i][/*]
 	[*]Champion Skin
[list]
 	[*]Accessory[/*]
 	[*]Body[/*]
 	[*]Voice Pack (included with Epic and above)[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]New Match Lobby presentation
[list]
 	[*]All team members Champion models now show on pedestals
[i]“We feel that this is a great way for players to get a better sense of their team composition and to show off their skin of choice”[/i][/*]
 	[*]Toggle Auto purchase items option added[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Introducing Uncommon rarity tier for Customizations
[list]
 	[*]Skins Moving into this Rarity
[list]
 	[*]Tyrant (Drogoz)[/*]
 	[*]Beast (Grohk)[/*]
 	[*]Monarch (Bombking)[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*][i]“This new rarity will include premium recolor skins where you will see entire color scheme and texture changes instead of the single, primary color shift you see with the Common tier”[/i][/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Price discount now given for bundle when already owning pieces.[/*]
 	[*]Removed Disenchant from Legendary and Gold Cards
[list]
 	[*][i]“After the ability to disenchant cards was introduced we noticed players were playing less champions than before as they were now disenchanting legendaries for champions they had not yet played. We want to preserve legendaries as powerful and valuable assets to the game and keep them as something that encourages players to play a variety of champions”[/i][/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Banner now pops up after an Item has been Auto Purchased from the Item Shop[/*]
 	[*]Added option to turn off Auto Purchase directly from Item Shop[/*]
 	[*]Increased volume of purchasable announcer packs[/*]
 	[*]Added an additional 10s to Customizing your Champion in Match Lobby[/*]
 	[*]Improvements made to Bomb King Announcer Pack
[list]
 	[*][i]“With the release of the Bomb King announcer pack we got feedback that Bomb King didn’t sound like himself. We had altered the process on his voice to be more clear and distinguished to assume the announcer role, but we realize that this move may have jeopardized qualities of his voice that people recognized. We have taken another pass at his voice to bring it more in line with the standard Bomb King Voicepack.”[/i][/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]GENERAL BUG FIXES
[list]
 	[*]Fixed Notification Center 'Go-to' link not taking you to correct items[/*]
 	[*]Fixed an issue that would cause a loud audio bug when using the arrow keys to adjust volume sliders.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]

[u][u][b]CUSTOMIZATIONS[/b][/u][/u]

[b]CHAMPIONS[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Ash
[list]
 	[*]Tempered
[list]
 	[*]Champion skin[/*]
 	[*]Weapon Skin[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Plated
[list]
 	[*]Champion skin[/*]
 	[*]Weapon skin[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Hellion (Uncommon)
[list]
 	[*]Champion skin[/*]
 	[*]Weapon skin[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]MISC
[list]
 	[*]Voice Pack: Ash[/*]
 	[*]Emote: Inferno[/*]
 	[*]Emote: Give me a break[/*]
 	[*]MVP: Aftermath[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Barik
[list]
 	[*]Stone-Cut
[list]
 	[*]Champion skin[/*]
 	[*]Weapon Skin[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Pip
[list]
 	[*]Pandamonium
[list]
 	[*]Champion skin[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[b]MOUNTS[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Scarlet Charger
[list]
 	[*][i]“Ride gloriously into battle on our first direct purchase mount”[/i][/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[b]CHESTS[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Added an Enchant Key option to guarantee no duplicates in the Radiant Chest[/*]
 	[*]New Chest - Champion Skin Chest
[list]
 	[*]Drops Full Champion skins of Rare, Epic and Legendary quality.
[list]
 	[*]Accessory[/*]
 	[*]Body[/*]
 	[*]Voice Pack if Epic Quality or Above[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]If a player rolls a Champion Skin that they already own a piece of, they will be granted an equivalent Essence value for the previously owned part.[/*]
 	[*]If a player owns all the parts of a Champion Skin then they will not roll that Champion Skin again from the chest[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]New Chest - Weapon Chest
[list]
 	[*]Includes Rare, Epic and Legendary Weapons.[/*]
 	[*]If a player owns a Weapon Skin then they will not roll that Weapon Skin again from the chest[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[i]“We are extremely excited to introduce these two new chests! With the Champion Skin chest you no longer have to get lucky multiple times to receive a full Champion Skin, and with the Weapon Chest, you no longer have test your luck against a large amount of non-weapon parts and pieces. We hope you enjoy this simpler and more rewarding experience!”[/i]

[b][u]MASTERY CUSTOMIZATIONS[/u][/b]

[i]“We are phasing out our beta rewards structure and bringing in some of the baddest mastery content in the realm. Mastery skins and customizations will be unlocked for purchase as you progress through your Champion’s Mastery levels. In this release, the following Champions will have Mastery Customizations: [b]Drogoz, Lex, Maeve, Makoa, Tyra, and Viktor[/b]. Expect to see more in the coming releases and we hope you love these Customizations as much as we do!”[/i]

Mastery MVP
[list]
 	[*]Unlocked for purchase at Level 5
[list]
 	[*]A unique MVP pose for your character that displays your Mastery level.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
Mastery Emote
[list]
 	[*]Unlocked for purchase at Level 8
[list]
 	[*]A unique Emote for your character that displays your Mastery level.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
Obsidian Mastery Skin
[list]
 	[*]Unlocked for purchase at Level 10[/*]
 	[*]Includes both Champion and Weapon skin[/*]
[/list]
Mastery Spray
[list]
 	[*]Unlocked for purchase at Level 12
[list]
 	[*]A unique Spray for your character that displays your Mastery level.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
Cosmic Mastery Skin
[list]
 	[*]Unlocked for purchase at Level 15[/*]
 	[*]Includes both Champion and Weapon skin[/*]
[/list]
[u]New Champion Mastery level rewards[/u]
[list]
 	[*]Level 1: Radiant Chest[/*]
 	[*]Level 2: Radiant Chest[/*]
 	[*]Level 3: 500 Gold[/*]
 	[*]Level 4: 500 Gold[/*]
 	[*]Level 5: Mastery MVP unlocks for purchase[/*]
 	[*]Level 6: Radiant Chest[/*]
 	[*]Level 8: Mastery Emote unlocks for purchase[/*]
 	[*]Level 10: Obsidian Mastery Skin unlocks for purchase[/*]
 	[*]Level 12: Mastery Spray unlocks for purchase[/*]
 	[*]Level 15: Cosmic Mastery Skin unlocks for purchase[/*]
 	[*]Level 20: Champion Title[/*]
[/list]

[u][u][b]MAPS[/b][/u][/u]
[list]
 	[*]Test Queue rotation
[list]
 	[*]New Map: Rift[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Design changes and features
[list]
 	[*]It is now possible to buy Items in the Shooting Range. Players have extra starting credits.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]MAP BUG FIXES
[list]
 	[*]Fixed a bug where players could not change Loadouts or Legendaries in the Shooting Range.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed an exploit on Frog Isle where it was possible to contest the payload cart through a wall.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed a bug on Ice Mines near the base where a wall was not blocking weapon projectiles.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed a bug on an Ice Mines spawn room damage volume that was damaging the wrong team.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed various exploits where it was possible to push or contest a payload through walls.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed some character lighting bugs in numerous levels.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]

[u][u][b]CHAMPIONS[/b][/u][/u]
[list]
 	[*][img]https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Androxus.jpg[/img][/*]
 	[*]Androxus
[list]
 	[*]Legendary
[list]
 	[*]Dark Stalker
[list]
 	[*]Increased the recharge rate of dashes by 1s
[list]
 	[*]“Dark Stalker is a lot of fun, because of the increased mobility and versatility, but Androxus always felt like he had one more dash. With this change he’ll have to be a little more careful.”[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Drogoz.jpg[/img][/*]
 	[*]Drogoz
[list]
 	[*]Legendary
[list]
 	[*]Fusillade
[list]
 	[*]Reduced direct shot bonus damage from 50% to 35%
[list]
 	[*][i]“Fusillade was always meant to be about awesome damage if you can land the shot. With the recent networking improvements made to Drogoz, this damage became a little too consistent.”[/i][/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Booster
[list]
 	[*]Reduced recharge rate by 17%.
[list]
 	[*][i]“One of Drogoz’s key strengths is his ability to stay in the air, this change allows him to stay airborne for just as long, but when he does hit the ground he’ll have to wait a bit longer to take flight.”[/i][/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/03/OB45-Inara-Profile-50x50.jpg[/img][/*]
 	[*]Inara
[list]
 	[*]Legendary Cards
[list]
 	[*]Mother’s Grace
[list]
 	[*]No longer grants Debuff Immunity.[/*]
 	[*]Now grants CC Immunity.
[list]
 	[*][i]“We’re happy with the boost Inara got last patch, but Debuff immunity was confusing and had some strange consequences. Moving to CC Immunity should be more clear without sacrificing much effectiveness.”[/i][/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Earthen Guard
[list]
 	[*]Now increases healing taken by 60%.
[list]
 	[*][i]“In losing Debuff immunity, Earthen Guard will no longer remove Cauterize. However, this change will allow Inara to get more healing even while under the effects of Cauterize, but also ensure that Cauterize is still useful against her. The two effects will stack additively against each other.”[/i][/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Stone Spear
[list]
 	[*]Firing Stone Spear will now apply a 40% movement speed slow to Inara while firing.
[list]
 	[*][i]“Inara was dealing a lot of damage, but we want to make sure that she isn’t chasing people down.”[/i][/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Grohk.jpg[/img][/*]
 	[*]Grohk
[list]
 	[*]Champion Price reduced from 200 Crystals 5000 Gold to 150 Crystals 4000 Gold
[list]
 	[*][i]“ As we grow our champion pool we will continue to discount some champions over time while new champions will retain their release price for longer.”[/i][/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Kinessa.png[/img][/*]
 	[*]Kinessa
[list]
 	[*]Legendary
[list]
 	[*]Steady Aim
[list]
 	[*]Increased time interval between empowered shots from 5 to 7s
[list]
 	[*][i]“Steady Aim is about taking your time to land those big shots, this should make that feel a little more natural.”[/i][/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/04/Seris_50x50.jpg[/img][/*]
 	[*]Seris
[list]
 	[*]Convergence
[list]
 	[*]Reduce the charge rate from dealing damage by 15%
[list]
 	[*][i]“We felt that Seris was able to charge her ultimate a little too easy through dealing damage, especially when following up after using Convergence. This does not affect her charge rate via healing..”[/i][/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/04/Profile_Willo_50x50.jpg[/img][/*]
 	[*]Willo
[list]
 	[*]General
[list]
 	[*]Increased health from 2000 to 2200[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Legendary
[list]
 	[*]Blastflower
[list]
 	[*]Increased the bonus damage per hit from 50 to 100.[/*]
 	[*]Now only stacks up to 3 times.
[list]
 	[*][i]“While Willo is not meant to be a duelist, she felt a little too vulnerable in a 1v1. These two change should help her in that situation, especially now that Blastflower gives her more damage sooner..”[/i][/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Scorn
[list]
 	[*]Reduced fuse time by 25%
[list]
 	[*]“With this change to Scorn, players opting into a Seedling-focused build should be able to be a little more consistent with their primary ability.”[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Fae Flight
[list]
 	[*]Weapon shots fired while in Fae Flight no longer consume ammo
[list]
 	[*]“Activating Fae Flight without reloading first could waste valuable time, now you won’t have to worry as you can fire your weapon freely during your ultimate.”[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]

[img]https://web2.hirez.com/paladins//wp-content/uploads/2017/05/50x50Ash.png[/img]
[list]

notes.notes:

[u][u][b]Get Rekt[/b][/u][/u][u][b]

[u][u][b]GENERAL[/b][/u][/u]
[list]

[i]Players are now able to purchase and equip custom announcer packs that will alter the in game announcements.
Purchase in Store > Items. Equip from Account settings.[/i]

[list]

 	[*]Fixed Report System to allow for more than 1 entry line.[/*]
 	[*]Champion AI when using VGS now use the correct button callout.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed localized languages showing incorrect and unlocalized text at Keybindings.[/*]
 	[*]Projectiles no longer consider shields for remote proximity distance (ex. Drogoz fire spit exploding on shields from far away)[/*]
 	[*]Fixed accuracy of projectiles on clients to closer match that on the server[/*]
 	[*]Fixed Grumpy Bomb and Salvo’s bonus damage to shields not reducing the bleed over damage to health[/*]
[/list]

[u][u][b]MAPS[/b][/u][/u]

[list]

[/list]
[/*]

 	[*]On Stone Keep, the payload now starts in the center the capture point, instead of off-center[/*]
 	[*]Jaguar Falls endzone moved back by 16 units[/*]
 	[*]Shooting Range
[list]
 	[*]Added a second patrolling Pip bot.[/*]
 	[*]Added a trigger circle to toggle the existence of the autofire Cassie bots. They are disabled by default.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Added push-success end of match cinematics to all siege maps[/*]
 	[*]Moved Top Play location for Timber Mill[/*]
[/list]
MAP BUG FIXES
[list]
 	[*]On Jaguar Falls, fixed a bug where the capture point was slightly off-center.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed visual bug on Frog Isle where distant fog was disabled.[/*]
 	[*]At the capture point on Fish Market, the tarps and second-floor crates are now symmetrical. The ropes no longer block weapons.[/*]

notes.notes:
[img]https://web2.hirez.com/paladins/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/OB49-ForumPost-PatchNotes-PTS.jpg[/img]

[h1][B]Forest’s Call Open Beta 49 Patch Notes | May 4th[/b][/h1]

[B]NEW CHAMPION: Willo, of the Summer Court[/B]

[url=https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/Patch-Preview-Content-Willo.jpg]Willo, of the Summer Court (Click to see image.)[/url]

[img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/Profile_Willo_50x50.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]Abilities
[img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/OB49_Willo_Ability_WandOfOvergrowth_50x50.png[/img]
[list]
[*][LMB] Wand of Overgrowth
[list]
[*]Fire a blast of fae energy that deals 500 damage every 0.75 seconds.
[/list]
[img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/OB49_Willo_Ability_DeadZone_50x50.png[/img]
[*][RMB] Dead Zone
[list]
[*]Fire out a toxic spore that prevents all healing in an area for 4s. Enemies affected by the spore that move out of the infested area cannot heal for 2s.
[/list]
[img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/OB49_Willo_Ability_Seedling50x50.png[/img]
[*][Q] Seedling
[list]
[*]Toss a seed that explodes after a 1 second fuse, dealing 500 damage and spawning 4 additional seeds that each explode for 500 damage after 1 second.
[/list]
[img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/OB49_Willo_Ability_Flutter_50x50.png[/img]
[*][F] Flutter
[list]
[*]Quickly flutter your wings and propel yourself forwards and upwards.
[/list]
[img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/OB49_Willo_Ability_FaeFlight_50x50.png[/img]
[*][E] Fae Flight
[list]
[*]Harness the power of the Fae and take to the sky for 10 seconds. 
[/list]
[/list]
[*]Cards
[img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/OB49_Willo_Legendary_Scorn_70x70.png[/img]
[list]
[*][b]Legendary[/b] - Scorn [Default]
[list]

[*]All PTS players will receive ample amounts of currency in order to purchase and test all of the new content on the PTS server! 
[/list]
==============================================================

[B]GENERAL BUG FIXES[/B]
[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where the 3rd item received from Radiant Chests wouldn’t display sometimes.
[*]Fixed various lobby sound bugs (mouse over Champion Audio clipping and countdown timer volume dropping).
[*]Fixed incorrect art displaying on gold card when unlocking Sprays in Radiant Chests.
[*]Fixed an issue where players who just gained their 12th Champion Mastery couldn’t join Competitive until relaunching the game.
[*]Fixed an issue where kicked Party members sometimes had their UI lock up after being re-invited.
[*]Fixed Top Play displaying incorrect border and Mastery.
[*]Fixed an issue where scrollbar was not working for Referred Friend list.
[*]Fixed reticle bloom sometimes not working for Tyra and Viktor.
[*]Fixed wrong values being displayed for all cards containing description “cannot be slowed”.
[*]Fixed match lobby portraits displaying as an incorrect icon.
[/list]


[B]General[/B]
[list]
[*]Competitive Rating Adjustments
	[list]
	[*][i]“We have tuned the rating system to remove the large and drastic ratings changes. The new ratings calculations should be more accurate and consistent as you play competitive”[/i]
	[/list]
[*]Integrated Voice Chat
	[list]
	[*]Voice chat is available in match lobby, during matches and end of match lobby.
	[*]Voice settings are available in Options > Audio
		[list]
		[*]Enable voice chat (Enabled by default).
		[*]Use voice chat push to talk (Disabled by default).
			[list]
			[*]Push to Talk setting found in Keybindings (Left Alt by default).
			[/list]
		[*]Voice chat speaker volume.
		[*]Voice chat microphone volume.
		[/list]
	[*]Mute
		[list]
		[*]Match Lobby: Mute Teammates by clicking on the speaker icon next to their portrait.
		[*]During Match: Open Scoreboard and click the speaker icon next to the player you wish to mute. Also available in the ESC Menu under Mute Players button.
		[/list]
[/list]
[*]PvE Challenge Que is being temporarily retired.
		[list]
		[*][i]“A big thankyou to all of our players who tested our Beta PvE queue! We are really pleased with the early results and involvement. We look forward to bringing you even more ambitious and polished encounters in the future! ”[/i]
		[/list]
[*]Added new server region: LatAm North
[*]Unique Per-Champion Keybindings
	[list]
	[*][i]“We are excited to make per-Champion keybindings available. A big part of mastering the game comes from customizing your interaction with it, and now you can! In order to ship saved keybindings per Champion, all player keybinds will be reset. Thank you for your understanding”[/i]
	[/list]
[*]Removed the item tally on the Radiant Chest screen
[*]Founder’s Pack purchase option added to Champion screen and Store
[/list]

	

[B]CHAMPIONS - BALANCE/UPDATES/FIXES[/B]
[img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_BombKing.jpg[/img]

[*][b]Barik[/b]
[list]
[*]Barricade
[list]
[*]The cooldown on Barricade will now start when it is destroyed or despawns
[list]
[*]“Our shielding system was a little too favourable in regards to it’s cooldown mechanics. It allowed players to begin counting down their ability cooldowns while still benefiting from the ability. With certain card combinations this lead to an extremely high shield uptime.”
[/list]
[/list]
[/list]
[img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Buck.jpg[/img]
[*][b]Buck[/b]
[list]
[*]Shotgun
[list]
[*]Increased Shotgun damage from 550 to 570
[list]

Fire a stream of magic projectiles from your hand that deal 210 damage every 0.3s. Your projectiles pass through enemies and apply a Soul Orb stack with every hit. Stacks up to 4 times.

[url=https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/Seris_RestoreSoul_80x80.png][img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/Seris_RestoreSoul_80x80.png[/img][/url][RMB] Restore Soul

Restore the soul of an ally. Healing them for 1000 health every second for 2 seconds.

[url=https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/Seris_RendSoul_80x80.png][img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/Seris_RendSoul_80x80.png[/img][/url][Q] Rend Soul

Detonate all of your active Soul Charges. Deal 100 damage to the afflicted enemy for every charge detonated. Every charge detonated also heals you for 15% of your maximum life.

[url=https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/Seris_ShadowTravel_80x80.png][img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/Seris_ShadowTravel_80x80.png[/img][/url][F] Shadow Travel

Step into another plane of reality for 5 seconds. While this ability is active you are in stealth and immune to all harmful effects.

Cast your soul core into the battlefield. After a delay, a tear in reality will manifest and drag in nearby enemies.

[url=https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/Seris_SoulOrbs_80x80.png][img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/Seris_SoulOrbs_80x80.png[/img][/url] [LMB] Soul Orb

Fire a stream of magic projectiles from your hand that deal 210 damage every 0.3s. Your projectiles pass through enemies and apply a Soul Orb stack with every hit. Stacks up to 4 times.

[url=https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/Seris_RestoreSoul_80x80.png][img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/Seris_RestoreSoul_80x80.png[/img][/url][RMB] Restore Soul

Restore the soul of an ally. Healing them for 1000 health every second for 2 seconds.

[url=https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/Seris_RendSoul_80x80.png][img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/Seris_RendSoul_80x80.png[/img][/url][Q] Rend Soul

Detonate all of your active Soul Charges. Deal 100 damage to the afflicted enemy for every charge detonated. Every charge detonated also heals you for 15% of your maximum life.

[url=https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/Seris_ShadowTravel_80x80.png][img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/Seris_ShadowTravel_80x80.png[/img][/url][F] Shadow Travel

Step into another plane of reality for 5 seconds. While this ability is active you are in stealth and immune to all harmful effects.

[url=https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/Seris_Convergence_80x80.png][img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/Seris_Convergence_80x80.png[/img][/url][E] Convergence

Cast your soul core into the battlefield. After a delay, a tear in reality will manifest and drag in nearby enemies.

[u][u][b]NEW CHAMPION: Lex, The Hand of Justice[/b][/u][/u]
[list]
 	[*][img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/Steam_Profile_Lex_50.jpg[/img][/*]
 	[*][b]Abilities[/b][/*]
[/list]
[img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/Lex_Weapon2.png[/img] [LMB] Magnums

Dual magnums that fire every 0.7s dealing 700 damage.

[img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/Lex_Pursuit.png[/img] [RMB] In Pursuit

Begin rapidly firing your Magnums at the nearest target to you with perfect aim. Deals 1050 damage over 1.5s. Automatically aims at the nearest target including deployables.

[img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/Lex_Retribution.png[/img] [Q] Retribution

You have a Retribution target that is revealed to you when nearby. Killing your target grants additional Credits if they are on a killstreak. Activating Retribution randomly selects a new target. Enemies that kill you automatically become your new target.

[img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/Lex_CombatSlide.png[/img] [F] Combat Slide

Activate to quickly slide forward in the direction you are facing.

[img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/Lex_TheLaw.png[/img] [E] The Law

After a charge up delay, release an infallible surge of judgement that executes targets in range at or below 65% Health. Targets above 65% will take 600 damage and be slowed for 1s. Requires line of sight and does not travel through shields.

[list]

 	[*][b]Abilities[/b][/*]
[/list]
[img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/Lex_Weapon2.png[/img] [LMB] Magnums

Dual magnums that fire every 0.7s dealing 700 damage.

[img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/Lex_Pursuit.png[/img] [RMB] In Pursuit

Begin rapidly firing your Magnums at the nearest target to you with perfect aim. Deals 1050 damage over 1.5s. Automatically aims at the nearest target including deployables.

[img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/Lex_Retribution.png[/img] [Q] Retribution

You have a Retribution target that is revealed to you when nearby. Killing your target grants additional Credits if they are on a killstreak. Activating Retribution randomly selects a new target. Enemies that kill you automatically become your new target.

[img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/Lex_CombatSlide.png[/img] [F] Combat Slide

Activate to quickly slide forward in the direction you are facing.

[img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/Lex_TheLaw.png[/img] [E] The Law

After a charge up delay, release an infallible surge of judgement that executes targets in range at or below 65% Health. Targets above 65% will take 600 damage and be slowed for 1s. Requires line of sight and does not travel through shields.

notes.title: Paladins players erupt in anger over 'pay-to-win' changes in latest patch

Players of Hi-Rez Studios' free-to-play hero shooter Paladins are venting their anger on Reddit and elsewhere over a recent change to the game that's widely seen as a blatant change to a "pay-to-win" system. The complaints are rooted in a new in-game currency called Essence, introduced in the open beta patch 44 that was rolled out last week.   

It sounds innocuous enough in the patch notes: Radiant chests are now purchasable for 3000 Gold, an in-game currency earned playing the game, and so instead of awarding gold for any duplicate items they contain, players now get Essence, which is used to unlock high-end cards. Under the previous system, gold did the trick, so players willing to do a little grinding could advance at a reasonable rate without having to spend any money.

The trouble, as Ten Ton Hammer breaks down, is that the ratio is entirely out of whack. The cost to do anything meaningful with Essence is tremendously high, exacerbated by a new "rarity" ranking for loadout cards. The site states that even after unlocking every card for every Champion, 36,000 Essence per Champion is required to access all their Legendary cards, an astounding 756,000 Essence in total. The amount of Essence awarded for a duplicate Common card? 60. 

The net result, according to multiple complaints in the Paladins subreddit, is that gold has been made effectively useless, and Paladins is now a pure pay-to-win proposition: You either fork over money for Crystals (the real-money currency), or you live without the bonuses and advantages that are granted to those who do. The new system is especially hard on new players, because veterans will keep the cards they've acquired under the old system, while newbies will have to start off with nothing.

Ironically, a post on Blizzard's Overwatch forums provided one of the most concise explanations of the core problem: Under this system, players are going to have to spend a ton if they want to get ahead. 

"The previous system was a winner, you could choose whichever card you wanted, for 1200 gold, and it didn't take long to grind that much by playing, usually 3-4 matches, not counting win of the day bonuses etc. Now they have a system where you have to spend gold on chests for RNG cards, and the only way to buy a card is with a new currency, which is only given when you get duplicate cards in the chests," author Zalamael wrote. 

"They allowed us to keep our cards, so long time players have every card available, with the exception of the new ones, but new players are screwed if they want a good deck. They can't even spend real money to level the playing field, because all they can do with real money is buy chests (so still suffer RNG) or buy boosters, which leads to the same problem. This isn't even a P2W system, because spending money wont get you ahead, unless you spend a fortune." 

So it's not pay-to-win in the absolute strictest sense—you can't straight up buy the powerful Legendary cards you want—but players will likely have to put in a good deal of cash just for a chance to obtain them.

Youtuber Joshino spent a few minutes at the start of this stream showing of how quickly even veteran players with more than 100,000 Essence can burn through the resource crafting Legendary cards, and explains why the system will be especially punishing for new players.

Most of the complaints on Reddit are calling for a return to the previous system, although at least one argues that the new system could be made to work by dramatically increasing the rate of Essence rewards, reducing the cost of Legendary cards, and doing away with the rarity system entirely. So far, Hi-Rez hasn't indicated which way it will go, or if it will simply stay the course, and that hasn't made players any happier. I've emailed Hi-Rez to find out more about the situation, and will update if and when I receive a reply.

[u][u][b]Legends of the Realm[/b][/u][/u][u][b]
[u]Open Beta 44 Patch Notes | February 17th[/u][/b][/u]
[url=http://forums.paladins.com/showthread.php?46-How-Hi-Rez-Makes-Games-and-Expectations-for-Beta][u]Beta Expectations[/u][/url]

[u][u][b]SEASON 1[/b][/u][/u]

Take your first steps into a new realm with powerful Legendary Cards. Season 1 brings about new ways to customize your play style, a brand new game mode that is not for the faint of heart, along with an overhaul to card crafting and looting.

LEGENDARY CARDS

Legendary cards are now available for all Champions. These cards are not placed inside of a loadout, but instead are selected at the start of the match and bring powerful benefits to each champion.
[list]
 	[*]Players now select one of their Legendary cards along with their loadout to further customize their play experience.[/*]
 	[*]Just like loadouts, once selected the Legendary card is locked in for the duration of the match.[/*]
 	[*]Legendary cards do not have any ranks.[/*]
 	[*]Champions each have 3 Legendary cards to choose from.[/*]
[/list]
[url=https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/Legendary_Stream.jpg][img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/Legendary_Stream-1024x576.jpg[/img][/url]

CARD CRAFTING & ESSENCE
[list]
 	[*]Radiant Chests are now purchasable for the cost of 3,000 Gold.[/*]
 	[*]Radiant Chests no longer drop Gold or provide Gold for duplicate items.[/*]
 	[*]A brand new type of currency called Essence will be given for duplicate items in the Radiant Chest.[/*]
 	[*]All loadout cards and Legendary cards are now unlocked using Essence.[/*]
 	[*]Loadout cards now have a rarity - ranging between Common, Rare, and Epic.
[list]
 	[*][i]Example:[/i]
[list]
 	[*]Onslaught I, Onslaught II, Onslaught III, and Onslaught IV are the [b]RANKS[/b] of the card "Onslaught".[/*]
 	[*]Onslaught (and all ranks of it) is an Epic card, where Epic is its [b]RARITY[/b].[/*]
 	[*]As before, when a card is unlocked it also unlocks all ranks of the card.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]The Loadout screen has been updated to show previews of loadout points spent.[/*]
[/list]
SCOREBOARD
[list]
 	[*]The in-match scoreboard has been updated to show each champion’s selected Legendary card.[/*]
 	[*]A new “Overview” section has been added to the scoreboard that shows a loadout summary for each player that shows the amount of loadout points placed into each category.[/*]
[/list]

[u][u][b]NEW GAME MODE: SURVIVAL[/b][/u][/u]

Team up with your friends to see who can survive the longest in the newest game mode, Survival. Survival is a permanent death five on five round based mode where death fog creeps in from the edge of the map, forcing teams to engage until one team is left standing.
[list]
 	[*]Survival is played on smaller maps in a best of 5 round based format.[/*]
 	[*]A short delay after each round begins, deathly fog will set in from the edges of the map as it closes in on the Epicenter.[/*]
 	[*]Once the death fog reaches the Epicenter, it will pause for 60s creating a final fight to the death.[/*]
 	[*]Death fog deals a percentage of a champion’s maximum health, and travels through all shields and damage reduction. The death fog is unbiased - it will kill all champions at the same rate and stops for no one.[/*]
 	[*]If a player dies during the round, they will not respawn until the next round.[/*]
 	[*]Survival is available on two maps:
[list]
 	[*]Primal Court[/*]
 	[*]Snowfall Junction[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[url=https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/Patch-Preview-Content-Survival-Snowfall-Junction.jpg][img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/Patch-Preview-Content-Survival-Snowfall-Junction-1024x576.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Open Beta 44 Patch Notes | February 17th
notes.notes:
[img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/OB44-Forum-PatchNotes.jpg[/img]
[u][u][b]Legends of the Realm[/b][/u][/u][u][b]
[u]Open Beta 44 Patch Notes | February 17th[/u][/b][/u]
[url=http://forums.paladins.com/showthread.php?46-How-Hi-Rez-Makes-Games-and-Expectations-for-Beta][u]Beta Expectations[/u][/url]

[u][u][b]SEASON 1[/b][/u][/u]

Take your first steps into a new realm with powerful Legendary Cards. Season 1 brings about new ways to customize your play style, a brand new game mode that is not for the faint of heart, along with an overhaul to card crafting and looting.

LEGENDARY CARDS

Legendary cards are now available for all Champions. These cards are not placed inside of a loadout, but instead are selected at the start of the match and bring powerful benefits to each champion.
[list]
 	[*]Players now select one of their Legendary cards along with their loadout to further customize their play experience.[/*]
 	[*]Just like loadouts, once selected the Legendary card is locked in for the duration of the match.[/*]
 	[*]Legendary cards do not have any ranks.[/*]
 	[*]Champions each have 3 Legendary cards to choose from.[/*]
[/list]
[url=https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/Legendary_Stream.jpg][img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/Legendary_Stream-1024x576.jpg[/img][/url]

CARD CRAFTING & ESSENCE
[list]
 	[*]Radiant Chests are now purchasable for the cost of 3,000 Gold.[/*]
 	[*]Radiant Chests no longer drop Gold or provide Gold for duplicate items.[/*]
 	[*]A brand new type of currency called Essence will be given for duplicate items in the Radiant Chest.[/*]
 	[*]All loadout cards and Legendary cards are now unlocked using Essence.[/*]
 	[*]Loadout cards now have a rarity - ranging between Common, Rare, and Epic.
[list]
 	[*][i]Example:[/i]
[list]
 	[*]Onslaught I, Onslaught II, Onslaught III, and Onslaught IV are the [b]RANKS[/b] of the card "Onslaught".[/*]
 	[*]Onslaught (and all ranks of it) is an Epic card, where Epic is its [b]RARITY[/b].[/*]
 	[*]As before, when a card is unlocked it also unlocks all ranks of the card.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]The Loadout screen has been updated to show previews of loadout points spent.[/*]
[/list]
SCOREBOARD
[list]
 	[*]The in-match scoreboard has been updated to show each champion’s selected Legendary card.[/*]
 	[*]A new “Overview” section has been added to the scoreboard that shows a loadout summary for each player that shows the amount of loadout points placed into each category.[/*]
[/list]

[u][u][b]NEW GAME MODE: SURVIVAL[/b][/u][/u]

Team up with your friends to see who can survive the longest in the newest game mode, Survival. Survival is a permanent death five on five round based mode where death fog creeps in from the edge of the map, forcing teams to engage until one team is left standing.
[list]
 	[*]Survival is played on smaller maps in a best of 5 round based format.[/*]
 	[*]A short delay after each round begins, deathly fog will set in from the edges of the map as it closes in on the Epicenter.[/*]
 	[*]Once the death fog reaches the Epicenter, it will pause for 60s creating a final fight to the death.[/*]
 	[*]Death fog deals a percentage of a champion’s maximum health, and travels through all shields and damage reduction. The death fog is unbiased - it will kill all champions at the same rate and stops for no one.[/*]
 	[*]If a player dies during the round, they will not respawn until the next round.[/*]
 	[*]Survival is available on two maps:
[list]
 	[*]Primal Court[/*]
 	[*]Snowfall Junction[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[url=https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/Patch-Preview-Content-Survival-Snowfall-Junction.jpg][img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/Patch-Preview-Content-Survival-Snowfall-Junction-1024x576.jpg[/img][/url]

[u][u][b]GENERAL[/b][/u][/u]

[u][u][b]NEW CHAMPION - Maeve, of Blades[/b][/u][/u]

[img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/Portrait_Maeve_50x50.jpg[/img]

[b]Abilities[/b]

[b][img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/Maeve_Blades.png[/img] [LMB] Daggers[/b]

Throw two Daggers every second that each deal 450 Damage.

[b][img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/Maeve_Pounce.png[/img] [RMB] Pounce[/b]

Quickly Dash Forward. Collide with an enemy to perform a melee Strike for 600 Damage.

[b][img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/Maeve_NineLives.png[/img] [Q] Nine Lives[/b]

Heal for 500 Health and reset the cooldowns of Pounce and Prowl.

[b][img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/Maeve_Midnight.png[/img] [E] Midnight[/b]

Enemies within 300ft have their vision restricted to a 30 foot radius for 4 seconds.

[b][img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/Maeve_Prowl.png[/img] [F] Prowl[/b]

Move 80% Faster and increase your jump height for 4 seconds. Firing your weapon or using another ability will cancel Prowl.

[b]Abilities[/b]

[b][img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/Maeve_Blades.png[/img] [LMB] Daggers[/b]

Throw two Daggers every second that each deal 450 Damage.

[b][img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/Maeve_Pounce.png[/img] [RMB] Pounce[/b]

Quickly Dash Forward. Collide with an enemy to perform a melee Strike for 600 Damage.

[b][img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/Maeve_NineLives.png[/img] [Q] Nine Lives[/b]

Heal for 500 Health and reset the cooldowns of Pounce and Prowl.

[b][img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/Maeve_Midnight.png[/img] [E] Midnight[/b]

Enemies within 300ft have their vision restricted to a 30 foot radius for 4 seconds.

[b][img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/Maeve_Prowl.png[/img] [F] Prowl[/b]

Move 80% Faster and increase your jump height for 4 seconds. Firing your weapon or using another ability will cancel Prowl.

notes.title: Open Beta 39 Patch Notes | December 5th
notes.notes:
[img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/OB39-Forum.jpg[/img]

[u][u][b]Merry Maker[/b][/u][/u][u][b]
[u]Open Beta 39 Patch Notes | December 5th[/u][/b][/u]


[url=http://forums.paladins.com/showthread.php?46-How-Hi-Rez-Makes-Games-and-Expectations-for-Beta][u]Beta Expectations[/u][/url]

[u][u][b]GENERAL[/b][/u][/u]
[list]
 	[*]Updated Founder's Packs to include:
[list]
 	[*]10 more Radiant chests to each Founder's Pack.[/*]
 	[*]All Standard Champion Voice Packs[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Account Boosters now provide additional Crystals and Gold for each Daily Login Bonus you collect.
[list]
 	[*]Bonus +5 Crystals[/*]
 	[*]Bonus +200 Gold[/*]
 	[*]Account Boosters still provide:
[list]
 	[*]+50% Account XP[/*]
 	[*]+50% Champion XP[/*]
 	[*]+100% Gold Earned[/*]
 	[*]Radiant Chests drop an additional item[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Unlocked items now have “owned” tag in Store and Champion Customize screen.[/*]
 	[*]Added Store filtering options for Items.[/*]
 	[*]Locked champions now appear greyed out in match lobby.[/*]
 	[*]Player's personal Health bars will now show shield health as a total health bar. The separation will show health, then shields, then missing health.[/*]
 	[*]Improved hitmarker feedback by increasing the length of the X and changing color when killing an enemy.[/*]
 	[*]Stat credit for personal shields now given to character that applied the shield[/*]
 	[*]Damage calculation against personal shields modified:[/*]
 	[*]Base damage applied first, before bonus damage to shields, resulting in less bleed over from personal shields to health[/*]
 	[*]Damage to personal shields now dismounts players[/*]
 	[*]Targetable health bar overlays improved so the shadow portion of the healthbar always represents only missing health, instead of missing health + missing shield[/*]
 	[*]Minor knockbacks no longer reduce air control[/*]
 	[*]Fixed an issue where player could be locked out from firing for an entire life under certain conditions on respawn[/*]
 	[*]Increased the max number of health segments, so they will more closely represent 250 health each for characters with high health[/*]
 	[*]Addressed an issue where sound loops would get stuck on if you interrupt them during KillCam (eg. Bomb King’s Ultimate rolling sound)[/*]
 	[*]Addressed an issue where Bomb King Sticky Bomb sounds were getting stuck on when you threw more than 6 Sticky Bombs before detonating.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed a bug where players could not view the scoreboard while on the items or loadouts screens.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed bug where if you interrupted your Emote with certain abilities it would allow you to move when you are supposed to be locked in place[/*]
 	[*]Improved the ability for “TakeHit” sounds to indicate the direction from which you were damaged.[/*]
[/list]

[u][u][b]COSMETICS[/b][/u][/u]
[list]
 	[*]Heads
[list]
 	[*]Merry Maker Ribbons[/*]
 	[*]Chillweave Beanie Kinessa[/*]
 	[*]Dasher’s Antlers Androxus[/*]
 	[*]Frosty Foliage Grover[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Weapons
[list]
 	[*]Merry Maker Cane Evie[/*]
 	[*]Festive Blunderbuss Barik[/*]
 	[*]Snow Cannon Makoa[/*]
 	[*]Festive Launcher Pip[/*]
 	[*]Jolly Longbow Sha Lin[/*]
 	[*]Twitch Illusory Mirror
[list]
 	[*]Exclusive skin for Twitch account linking.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Bodies
[list]
 	[*]Merry Maker Evie[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Voice Packs
[list]
 	[*]Merry Maker Evie[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]

[u][u][b]MAPS[/b][/u][/u]
[list]
 	[*]Ice Mines
[list]
 	[*]Ice Mines has had a visual theming pass.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]

[u][u][b]CHAMPIONS - BALANCE/UPDATES/FIXES[/b][/u][/u]
[list]
 	[*]General
[list]
 	[*]Addressed a bug where knockbacks would have different behavior based on the position of the source.[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Buck.jpg[/img][/*]
 	[*]Buck
[list]
 	[*][i]“Buck excels as a Flanker, but boasts a large amount of control for how mobile he is. We want to reward players who consistently land Net Shots, and Heroic Leap’s slow allowed Buck to extend the slow duration longer than it should last.”[/i][/*]
 	[*]Heroic Leap
[list]
 	[*]No longer slows enemies upon landing.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Evie.jpg[/img][/*]
 	[*]Evie
[list]
 	[*]Ice Block
[list]
 	[*]Ice block is now able to be themed for skins.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Cards
[list]
 	[*][i]“Wormhole provided Evie too much breathing room around using her Blink, and was too valuable at ranks 1 and 2. Reducing the scale down means players now need to place more points into Wormhole to get similar value out of it.”[/i][/*]
 	[*]Wormhole
[list]
 	[*]Reduced duration allowing the return blink from 2/4/6/8 to 1/2/3/4s.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Drogoz.jpg[/img][/*]
 	[*]Drogoz
[list]
 	[*][i]“Through card combinations and precise timing Drogoz players were able to exceed booster’s maximum speed for long durations of time allowing for an unintended amount of mobility. With the new booster behaviour he can still momentarily hit high speeds but will not be able to maintain them.”[/i][/*]
 	[*]Booster
[list]
 	[*]Implemented a gradual speed reduction to booster when surpassing the maximum intended speed.[/*]
 	[*]Booster is now disabled for 1 second after being knocked back[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Fernando.jpg[/img][/*]
 	[*]Fernando
[list]
 	[*][i]“Fernando is a formidable Front Line to deal with and can bring incredible point control to his team. However, we feel Fernando excels a bit too much at chasing enemies. We are reducing his base Movement Speed and Health to ensure risky positioning stays risky as it gave him a lot of forgiveness if he chased too far. The Cooldown recovery mechanic was short enough along with his ability to chase where it allowed Fernando to play more of a Flank role.”[/i][/*]
 	[*]General
[list]
 	[*]Reduced Health from 5700 to 5500.[/*]
 	[*]Reduced Movement Speed from 365 to 360.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Shield
[list]
 	[*]Increased the minimum Cooldown when cancelling Shield early based on amount of Health remaining from 7 to 9s.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Kinessa.png[/img][/*]
 	[*]Kinessa
[list]
 	[*]Transporter
[list]
 	[*]Reduced Cooldown from 12 to 10s.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Makoa.jpg[/img][/*]
 	[*]Makoa
[list]
 	[*][i]“Makoa excels at isolating targets and provides a strong contrast to the other Front Line champions in that way. He falls a bit behind champions like Fernando or Barik in point control, but we want to highlight his uniqueness by increasing the amount of damage he can deal.”[/i][/*]
 	[*]Ancient Rage
[list]
 	[*]Increased damage from 600 to 650.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Cannon
[list]
 	[*]Increased damage from 600 to 650.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/Profile_MalDamba.jpg[/img][/*]
 	[*]Mal’Damba
[list]
 	[*][i]“While Mal’Damba has a strong list of healing and control options for his team, his survivability is lower than other Support champions. We are increasing his base Health to allow him to take a few extra hits and stay in the fight.”[/i][/*]
 	[*]General
[list]
 	[*]Increased Health from 2500 to 2650.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/Profile-ShaLin.jpg[/img][/*]
 	[*]Sha Lin
[list]
 	[*]Cards
[list]
 	[*]Grounded
[list]
 	[*]Fixed an issue where this card was healing for 13% less than intended at all ranks.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Ying.jpg[/img][/*]
 	[*]Ying
[list]
 	[*]Cards
[list]
 	[*][i]“Carry On held too much value at low ranks, giving a significant increase in healing output without encouraging the player to put a lot of points into it in their loadout.”[/i][/*]
 	[*]Carry On
[list]
 	[*]Reduced the amount of duration increase from 3/6/9/12 to 1/2/3/4s.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]

[u][u][b]SPECTATOR[/b][/u][/u]
[list]
 	[*]The Spectator UI has had a presentation update with new features.[/*]
[/list]

[/*]

[list]

[list]

[/list]
[/*]

[/*]

The Cooldown recovery mechanic was short enough along with his ability to chase where it allowed Fernando to play more of a Flank role.”[/i][/*]

[list]
 	[*]Reduced Cooldown from 12 to 10s.[/*]

[list]
 	[*]Increased damage from 600 to 650.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Cannon
[list]
 	[*]Increased damage from 600 to 650.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]

[/list]

[/list]
[/*]
[/list]

[list]

[list]
 	[*]Updated firing sound.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]

 	[*]Sha Lin
[list]
 	[*]Cards
[list]
 	[*]Bullseye
[list]
 	[*]Fixed an issue where this card was not working at times.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Oasis
[list]
 	[*]Fixed an issue where this card was not working at times.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Quick Sand
[list]
 	[*]Fixed an issue where this card was not working at times.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]

[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Viktor.jpg[/img][/*]
 	[*]Viktor
[list]
 	[*][i]“Viktor is filling the role we expect for him, but is effective at too far of a range. Bringing in the range at which his damage starts to fall off and adding a slight additional recoil to his Iron Sights by default means he will be less effective fighting from a sniper’s range.”[/i][/*]
 	[*]Assault Rifle
[list]
 	[*]Weapon falloff damage now starts at 90ft instead of 135ft.[/*]

[/list]
[/*]

[list]

[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Ying.jpg[/img][/*]

notes.title: Open Beta 37 Patch Notes | November 10, 2016
notes.notes:
[img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/OB37-Forum.jpg[/img]

[u][u][b]The Desert Wind[/b][/u][/u][u][b][u]Open Beta 37 Patch Notes | November 8th[/u][/b][/u]
[url=http://forums.paladins.com/showthread.php?46-How-Hi-Rez-Makes-Games-and-Expectations-for-Beta][u]Beta Expectations[/u][/url]

[u][u][b]NEW CHAMPION: Sha Lin, The Desert Wind[/b][/u][/u][list] 	[*][img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/Profile-ShaLin.jpg[/img][/*] 	[*]Weapon [LMB] - Long Bow[list] 	[*]A long bow that draws back an arrow and releases it for up to 1100 damage every 1.5s.[/*][/list][/*] 	[*]Secondary Fire [RMB] - Impaler Arrow[list] 	[*]Replace your arrow with an Impaler Arrow that knocks enemies back and stuns them for 1s if they hit a wall.[/*][/list][/*] 	[*]Ability [Q] - Planted[list] 	[*]Plant yourself in place, becoming stationary for 3s. While planted, your Long Bow draw time is increased by 200% and you fire continuously. Re-activating Planted cancels the ability.[/*][/list][/*] 	[*]Ability [F] - Withdraw[list] 	[*]Leap backwards and enter stealth for 2s, leaving a mirage at your original location for 3.5s.[/*][/list][/*] 	[*]Ultimate [E] - Heat Haze[list] 	[*]Enter stealth and gain 30% Movement Speed for 8s. While active, you draw your bow 50% faster and leave a mirage behind for 2s each time you fire.[/*][/list][/*][/list] [list] 	[*]Cards[list] 	[*]Swagger[list] 	[*][Armor] Gain 50/100/150/200 Health.[/*][/list][/*] 	[*]Bullseye[list] 	[*][Weapon] Reduce all active cooldowns by 10/20/30/40% when getting an elimination.[/*][/list][/*] 	[*]Poise[list] 	[*][Armor] Gain 5/10/15/20% Crowd Control Reduction.[/*][/list][/*] 	[*]Wanderlust[list] 	[*][Armor] Gain 5/10/15/20% movement speed.[/*][/list][/*] 	[*]Quick Sand[list] 	[*][Impaler Arrow] Increase the recharge rate of Impaler Arrow by 5/10/15/20%.[/*][/list][/*] 	[*]Strike True[list] 	[*][Impaler Arrow] Heal for 50/100/150/200 when striking an enemy with Impaler arrow.[/*][/list][/*] 	[*]Flying Circus[list] 	[*][Impaler Arrow] Gain 10/20/30/40% Movement Speed after hitting Impaler Arrow.[/*][/list][/*] 	[*]Skewer[list] 	[*][Impaler Arrow] Impaler arrows reveal enemies for 1/2/3/4s.[/*][/list][/*] 	[*]Grounded[list] 	[*][Planted] Regenerate 50/100/150/200 Health per second while in Planted.[/*][/list][/*] 	[*]Master Archer[list] 	[*][Planted] Reduce the cooldown of Planted by 1/2/3/4s.[/*][/list][/*] 	[*]Daring Escape[list] 	[*][Planted] Gain 10/20/30/40% movement speed for 3s after Planted ends.[/*][/list][/*] 	[*]Windwall[list] 	[*][Planted] Gain 3/6/9/12% Damage Reduction during Planted[/*][/list][/*] 	[*]Run Like the Wind[list] 	[*][Withdraw] After using Withdraw gain 10/20/30/40% Movement Speed for 3s.[/*][/list][/*] 	[*]Oasis[list] 	[*][Withdraw] After using Withdraw heal for 50/100/150/200.[/*][/list][/*] 	[*]Mirage[list] 	[*][Withdraw] Reduce the cooldown of Withdraw by 1/2/3/4.[/*][/list][/*] 	[*]Shimmer[list] 	[*][Withdraw] Gain 10/20/30/40% damage reduction during Withdraw's stealth.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list] [u][u][b]GENERAL[/b][/u][/u][list] 	[*]Multi-queuing is now available. Players can choose to queue for both Siege and Payload simultaneously, which will enter whichever queue comes up first.[/*] 	[*]The Store has undergone a visual and functional update. All items in the game as well as new items can be viewable in the store. Chests will now be located in the Store as well.[/*] 	[*]Item previews in the store will now more clearly show what is changing on the champion.[/*] 	[*]The champion customization screen has undergone a visual and functional update, allowing you to preview items together including those you don’t own.[/*] 	[*]Players can now swap champions at the end of the picking stage in a Competitive Queue match lobby.[/*] 	[*]Improvements to the audio system.[/*] 	[*]Addressed an issue where using a rapid movement ability under a ceiling would cause you to jitter.[/*] 	[*]Addressed an issue where the first reload of the match would not display correctly.[/*] 	[*]Best in Class namings are now team colored to show what team each player was on.[/*] 	[*]Fixed an issue where keybindings would get reset with a new patch.[/*] 	[*]Fixed an issue where players would get stuck on the Top Play screen.[/*] 	[*]Improved the algorithm for determining the Top Play.[/*] 	[*]While active, Account Boosters now cause Radiant Chests to drop a 4th item.[/*] 	[*]Addressed an issue where players would sometimes not get a mount upon spawning.[/*] 	[*]Fixed an issue where some abilities would still deal damage into an enemy spawn room.[/*] 	[*]Capture Points may no longer be progressed until the round has begun.[/*][/list] [u][u][b]COSMETICS[/b][/u][/u][list] 	[*]The Colossal Chest is now available and includes the exclusive Plushy and Cuddly Makoa skins as well as other Rare, Epic, and exclusive Rare items.
[img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Makoa.jpg[/img][list] 	[*]Head[list] 	[*]Plushy Googly Eyes[/*] 	[*]Cuddly Googly Eyes[/*][/list][/*] 	[*]Body[list] 	[*]Plushy Makoa[/*] 	[*]Cuddly Makoa[/*][/list][/*] 	[*]Weapon[list] 	[*]Plushy Cannon[/*] 	[*]Cuddly Cannon[/*][/list][/*][/list][img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/Profile-ShaLin.jpg[/img][/*] 	[*]Sha Lin[list] 	[*]Head[list] 	[*]Bravado Headband[/*] 	[*]Charisma Headband[/*] 	[*]Renowned Headband[/*][/list][/*] 	[*]Body[list] 	[*]Bravado[/*] 	[*]Charisma[/*] 	[*]Renowned[/*][/list][/*] 	[*]Weapon[list] 	[*]Bravado Long Bow[/*] 	[*]Charisma Long Bow[/*] 	[*]Renowned Long Bow[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*] 	[*]Poses are now available in the Radiant Chest that provide custom poses for the Best in Class screen at the end of a match.[/*] 	[*]Each champion now has a Common skin only available in the Radiant Chest.[/*][/list] [u][u][b]SPECTATOR[/b][/u][/u][list] 	[*]Fixed issue where Androxus Ult would not show up correctly for the spectated player.[/*] 	[*]Added spectator options menu that only shows up while spectating.[/*][/list] [u][u][b]MAPS[/b][/u][/u][list] 	[*]Timber Mill has undergone a visual update along with various cleanups.[/*] 	[*]Timber Mill now features portals that take players up onto select rooftops.[/*] 	[*]Fixed an issue where Fish Markets would not display Top Play correctly.[/*] 	[*]Fixed an issue where players could get underneath Frog Isle.[/*] 	[*]Fixed an issue where team decorations were not displaying correctly on Fish Markets.[/*][/list] [u][u][b]CHAMPIONS - BALANCE/UPDATES/FIXES[/b][/u][/u][list] 	[*]Burn Cards[list] 	[*]Wrecker[list] 	[*]Shield damage increased from 50/100/150% to 75/150/225%.[*][i]“We felt that Frontline characters who rely on shields were taking too much of a powerful position in matches of all levels. To address this we’ve increased the effect of their counter, Wrecker, and will be monitoring this change closely.”[/i][/*][/list][/*][/list][img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Androxus.jpg[/img][/*] 	[*]Androxus[list] 	[*]Cards[list] 	[*]Marksman[list] 	[*]Fixed an issue where this card was not working at all ranks.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Buck.jpg[/img][/*] 	[*]Buck[list] 	[*]Net Shot[list] 	[*]Fixed an issue where Net shot was granting 15% bonus damage, instead of 30%.[/*][/list][/*][/list][img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Cassie.jpg[/img][/*] 	[*]Cassie[list] 	[*]Cards[list] 	[*]Incitement[list] 	[*]Fixed an issue where this card was not working at all ranks.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Grohk.jpg[/img][/*] 	[*]Grohk[list] 	[*]Cards[list] 	[*]Crackle[list] 	[*]Fixed an issue where this card was granting 1s increased healing totem duration at all ranks. Card is now correctly 1/2/3/4s.[/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Grover.jpg[/img][/*] 	[*]Grover[list] 	[*]General[list] 	[*]Reduced Health from 2900 to 2700.[*][i]“Grover is a versatile character able to provide strong healing when pushed up with his team, or powerful damage from range. We like the role he is filling, but feel he is too inherently defensive with how sturdy he is at base. In future patches, we will look to enhance his skillset over his natural tankiness.”[/i][/*][/list][/*] 	[*]Throwing Axe[list] 	[*]Description updated to reflect that the increased damage over range is Bonus Damage.[/*][/list][/*][/list][img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Kinessa.png[/img][/*] 	[*]Kinessa[list] 	[*]Sniper Mode[list] 	[*]Updated description to reflect that kinessa gains 30% bonus damage for fully charged shots.[/*][/list][/*] 	[*]Oppressor Mine[list] 	[*]Description updated to reflect that the increased damage from Sniper Rifle’s Carbine mode is Bonus Damage.[/*][/list][/*][/list][img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/Profile_MalDamba.jpg[/img][/*] 	[*]Mal Damba[list] 	[*]Spitting Cobra[list] 	[*]Updated description to explain Bonus Damage from reloading.[/*][/list][/*][/list][img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Pip.jpg[/img][/*] 	[*]Pip[list] 	[*]Explosive Flask[list] 	[*]Updated description to correctly show bonus damage.[/*] 	[*]Reduced bonus damage on successive shots from 30% to 20%.[*][i]“We like Pip utilizing his mobility and strong crowd control effects to stand out in the Support role. While we like how aggressive he can be, we want to make sure he is primarily a Support pick, so we’ve taken down his burst potential after Explosive Flask and increased his healing with Healing Potion.”[/i][/*][/list][/*] 	[*]Healing Potion[list] 	[*]Increased healing from 1000 to 1200.[/*][/list][/*][/list][img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Ying.jpg[/img][/*] 	[*]Ying[list] 	[*]General[list] 	[*]Reduced Health from 2500 to 2350.[/*][/list][/*] 	[*]Illusion[list] 	[*]Reduced healing per second of Illusions from 400 to 350.[*][i]“Ying has consistently been providing the strongest healing throughput of all supports. We like her to be able to heal her allies with cleverly placed Illusions, but we felt that her throughput was too far out of line compared to other supports when combined with her survivability and elusiveness.”[/i][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list] [u][u][b]ACHIEVEMENTS[/b][/u][/u][list] 	[*]Master Collector[list] 	[*]Unlock 100 Cards[/*][/list][/*] 	[*]Last One Standing[list] 	[*]Be the only player alive in a match[/*][/list][/*] 	[*]Give 100 Percent[list] 	[*]Get a killing blow after the round has ended[/*][/list][/*] 	[*]Gone Spelunking[list] 	[*]Die to an environmental hazard[/*][/list][/*] 	[*]Send Off[list] 	[*]Kill a player with an environmental hazard[/*][/list][/*] 	[*]Sniper[list] 	[*]Kill an enemy player from over 300 ft away[/*][/list][/*] 	[*]Counter-Air Defense[list] 	[*]Kill a player in the air who is over 100 ft above the ground[/*][/list][/*] 	[*]Not Like This[list] 	[*]Kill an enemy player while you are at or below 50 health[/*][/list][/*] 	[*]Bounty Hunter[list] 	[*]Kill an enemy player who is on a 15 killstreak or higher[/*][/list][/*] 	[*]I Like Big Numbers[list] 	[*]Deal more than 100,000 damage during a match[/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Open Beta 36 Patch Notes | The Pumpkin Patch
notes.notes:
[img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/OB36_Forum.jpg[/img]

[B]The Pumpkin Patch
Open Beta 36 Patch Notes | October 24th[/B]
[URL="http://forums.paladins.com/showthread.php?46-How-Hi-Rez-Makes-Games-and-Expectations-for-Beta"]Beta Expectations[/URL]

[B]GENERAL[/B]

[list]
[*]At the end of every match, players will now see the Top Play from that match.
[*]Added Boosters that increase the rate at which players gain Experience and Gold, available in 7-day and 30-day options.
[*]Players that play together in a party will now get 10% more Experience and Gold.
[*]Players may now trade champions at the end of a draft lobby.
[*]Added a screen to display the top player of each role to the end of match lobby.
[*]Addressed a variety of issues with when and how music is played.
[*]Added new music for when both teams are tied at 3 points.
[*]General improvements to audio system:
[list]
[*][i]“We’ve enabled an improved occlusion system to increase clarity around what sounds are being made in the immediate vicinity of the player. Sounds on the other sides of walls should be occluded, although ultimates will never be affected by this system. This is the first step in a series of ongoing improvements to our audio system.”[/i]
[/list]
[*]Added options to control aim acceleration on gamepad.
[*]Added gradiated movement speed on the left thumbstick for gamepad.
[*]Shooting range will now automatically show a champion selection screen.
[*]Shooting range champ select should make the esc menu go away when a champ is selected.
[*]Increased experience gained from completing the Basic Tutorial.
[*]Added a warning dialog for skipping the tutorial to indicate that the player is missing out on rewards.
[*]Added region flags to each player on the leaderboard.
[*]Radiant Chests now randomly drop Gold ranging from 400 to 1000, in addition to cards and cosmetics.
[*]Addressed an issue where players could duo queue into competitive without having 12 champions at Mastery 4.
[*]The champions page now shows each champion’s rating by frame.
[*]Players in the shooting range may now change their deck at any time.
[*]Added additional matchmaking logic.
[*]Added the Emote key to the keybindings menu.
[*]Siege Game Mode:
[list]
[*][i]“We have made several updates to the Siege game mode. Our goal is to improve the early to late game scaling, and ensure there are enough incentives to both capture the objective as well as push the payload cart successfully. We have also added additional incentives for champions in each role to play to their strengths. We will continue to evaluate Siege in coming patches.”[/i]
[*]Objectives and Payload carts no longer progress faster with multiple players, one player will give the maximum amount of progress.
[*]Objective capture rate and Payload cart speed now increases over the course of the match.
[*]The team that captures the Objective gains an additional 300 credits per player.
[*]The defending team no longer gains credits when successfully defending the Payload push.
[*]Objective capture rate and Payload cart speed is no longer altered when you are ahead or behind in points.
[/list]
[*]Each role now gains additional credits for doing their intended role:
[list]
[*]Front Line champions gain 100% more credits for standing near an objective.
[*]Support champions gain 100% more credits for healing allies.
[*]Flank champions gain 100% more credits for eliminations on enemies when they are behind enemy lines.
[*]Damage champions gain 100% more credits for dealing damage to enemy champions.
[/list]
[*]Addressed an issue where players could crash when loading into a match.
[/list]

[B]SKINS/WEAPONS[/B]

[list]
[img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Grover.jpg[/img]
[*]Grover
[list]
[*]Grover may now customize accessories for his head separately from his body.
[*]Common Skins 
[list]
[*]Autumn
[*]Saffron
[*]Lavender
[/list]
[/list]
[img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Buck.jpg[/img]
[*]Buck
[list]
[*]Buck may now customize accessories for his head separately from his body.
[*]Buck’s character model has undergone visual updates. The old model and its variants remain as optional skins.
[*]Epic Skins
[list]
[*]Triggerman 
[*]Kingpin 
[/list]
[*]Rare Skins
[list]
[*]Brawler
[*]Envy
[/list]
[*]Common Skins
[list]
[*]Summit
[*]Alpine
[*]Mesa
[/list]
[/list]
[img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_BombKing.jpg[/img]
[*]Bomb King
[list]
[*]Epic Skins
[list]
[*]Pumpking
[/list]
[/list]
[/list]

[B]SPECTATOR[/B]

[list]
[*]UI now shows ultimate status, health, and highlights currently selected player.
[*]Now more clearly shows what player is currently highlighted.
[*]Persistent objective text is no longer displayed in spectator mode.
[*]Spectators can now fly through spawn gates.
[*]Fixed an issue where frame color of bottom elements was inversed.
[*]Deck name is no longer shown.
[/list]

[B]MAPS[/B]

[list]
[*]Added art to the Shooting range
[/list]

[B]CHAMPIONS - BALANCE/UPDATES/FIXES[/B]

[list]
[*]General
[list]
[*]Improved firing range of hitscan weapons.
[/list]
[img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Drogoz.jpg[/img]
[*]Drogoz
[list]
[*]Dragon Punch
[list]
[*]Reduced duration in flight from 5s to 4s.
[/list]
[*]Salvo
[list]
[*]Increased bonus damage to shields per hit from +100% to +200%.
[/list]
[/list]
[img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Fernando.jpg[/img]
[*]Fernando
[list]
[*]Charge
[list]
[*][i]“We like where Fernando is sitting in a team composition, but feel he is too good at chasing kills and repositioning. This change is aimed at bringing him more in line with his role.”[/i]
[*]Increased cooldown from 6 to 8s.
[/list]
[/list]
[img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/Profile_MalDamba.jpg[/img]
[*]Mal’Damba
[list]
[*]Gourd
[list]
[*][i]“Mal’Damba’s Gourd was intended to have a strong area of effect impact, and was not filling that role with the healing and damage it dealt.”[/i]
[*]Increased healing from 200 to 280 per second.
[*]Increased damage from 100 to 200 per second.
[/list]
[*]Spitting Cobra
[list]
[*]Reduced the effective hit size of Spitting Cobra’s projectile.
[/list]
[*]Snake Toss
[list]
[*]Increased the effective hit size of Snake Toss’ projectile.
[/list]
[/list]
[img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Makoa.jpg[/img]
[*]Makoa
[list]
[*]Cannon
[list]
[*]Increased the distance at which Cannon’s damage starts its fall off from 40 to 60 units.
[/list]
[/list]
[list]
[*]Shell Shield
[list]
[*]Shell Shield’s channel is now interrupted by hard crowd control effects.
[/list]
[/list]
[img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Skye.jpg[/img]
[*]Skye
[list]
[*]Fixed bug where minimum accuracy was too low.
[/list]
[img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/Profile_Ying.jpg[/img]
[*]Ying
[list]
[*]Illusion
[list]
[*]Reduced duration from 12 to 8s.
[/list]
[/list]
[/list]

notes.notes:
[img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/OB35_Forum.jpg[/img]

[B]Feast of the Serpent
Open Beta 35 Patch Notes | October 11th[/B]
[URL="http://forums.paladins.com/showthread.php?46-How-Hi-Rez-Makes-Games-and-Expectations-for-Beta"]Beta Expectations[/URL]

[B]New Champion: Mal'Damba, Wekono's Chosen[/B]

[list]
[img]https://hzweb.hi-rezgame.net/paladins-web/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/Profile_MalDamba.jpg[/img]
[*]Weapon [LMB] - Spitting Cobra
[list]
[*]Fires as glob of venom every .55s dealing 450 damage to a single target.
[*]Bonus Damage: Reloading throws the cobra dealing up to 550 based on how much ammo is missing and stunning enemies for 1s.
[/list]
[*]Secondary Fire [RMB] - Mending Spirits
[list]
[*]Summon a spirit to enchant an ally healing 280 Health every second for 5 seconds.
[/list]
[*]Ability [Q] - Gourd
[list]
[*]Toss a gourd full of venom that heals allies for 200 Health every second and damages enemies for 100 Damage every second.
[/list]
[*]Ability [F] - Slither
[list]
[*]Quickly slither forward, becoming untargetable for the duration.
[/list]
[*]Ultimate [E] - Dread Serpent
[list]
[*]Fire a dark vessel that explodes when it lands, fearing all enemy Champions for 2s and causing them to take 20% additional damage from all sources for the duration.
[/list]
[*]Cards
[list]
[*]Incorporeal
[list]
[*]Gain 50/100/150/200 Health.
[/list]
[*]Feed the Spirits
[list]
[*]Reduce all active cooldowns by 10/20/30/40% when getting an elimination.
[/list]
[*]Snake Pit
[list]
[*]Gain 5/10/15/20% Reload Speed.
[/list]
[*]Sustenance
[list]
[*]Receive 5/10/15/20% more healing when below 50% Health.
[/list]
[*]Eerie Presence
[list]
[*]Reduce the cooldown of Mending Spirits by .5/1/1.5/2s if you miss.
[/list]
[*]Ritual Magic
[list]
[*]Heal for 15/30/45/60 Health every second Mending Spirits is active on an ally.
[/list]
[*]Swift Spirits
[list]
[*]Mending Spirits grants 7/14/21/28% Movement Speed to allies.
[/list]
[*]Possession
[list]
[*]Gain 4/8/12/16% Damage Reduction every second Mending Spirits is active on an ally.
[/list]
[*]Many Gourds
[list]
[*]Reduce the Cooldown of Gourd by .5/1/1.5/2s.
[/list]
[*]Venomous Gourd
[list]
[*]Gourd generates 1/2/3/4 ammo.
[/list]
[*]Lighter Gourd
[list]
[*]Gourd gains 10/20/30/40% projectile speed.
[/list]
[*]Pungent Gourd
[list]
[*]Gain vision on enemies for .5/1/1.5/2s after hitting them with Gourd.
[/list]
[*]Liminal Passage
[list]
[*]Increase the distance Slither travels by 10/20/30/40%.
[/list]
[*]Fleeting
[list]
[*]Reduce the Cooldown of Slither by .5/1/1.5/2s.
[/list]
[*]Spirit’s Touch
[list]
[*]Activating Slither heals you for 50/100/150/200
[/list]
[*]Otherworldly
[list]
[*]Gain 10/20/30/40% Movement Speed for 2s after Slither ends.
[/list]
[/list]
[/list]

[B]GENERAL[/B]

[list]
[*]Added a Tutorial for new players to learn the game.
[*]Improved Custom match support
[*]Players can now purchase cards for gold during the Loadout import process
[*]Improved jitters near payload
[*]Net code improvements (smoother movement corrections)
[*]Fixed an issue where champions’ voices would react to getting healed when they were already at full health.
[*]Players can now copy decks from the leaderboard
[*]Fixed a bug where longer chat messages would get cut off
[*]Addressed an issue where the overtime bar would get stuck on
[*]Extend Payload round begin phase for attackers from 30s to 50s (Defenders can still leave their base at 10s).
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug with round 2 of Payload where both teams lose 5 seconds from their preparation time due to the slow motion effect at the end of round 1.
[/list]
[*]Party members have a slightly different tint in-game
[*]Sources of healing, such as Ying illusions, now have a + icon above them
[*]Added crystal icons to the loading screen to signify that players are still loading.
[*]Added an audio notification during overtime.
[*]Added Cyrillic font to the game
[*]Fixed a number of crash conditions.
[*]Additional VFX performance updates for low end machines.
[*]New emotes are now available. 
[/list]

[B]UI[/B]

[list]
[*]Locked champions now are desaturated and have a lock frame.
[*]Champions that are not able to be selected now have a strikethrough presentation.
[*]Updated champion mastery frame art.
[/list]

notes.notes:
